axis_calibration.interpretation: Consistency residual from fitting published vector gridline centers.

method_sensitivity.basis: Maximum absolute change among all eight marker-derived rates when replacing the earlier manual plot-frame calibration with vector-native gridline calibration.

adopted_extraction_uncertainty.reason: The vector-axis fit residual is much smaller than the observed calibration-method sensitivity. FireSense therefore uses the larger method-sensitivity value as a conservative v0 figure-extraction uncertainty bound.

separation_policy.digitization_or_extraction_uncertainty: Represents uncertainty introduced by recovering numerical values from the published figure representation.
separation_policy.experimental_uncertainty: Represents variability or uncertainty reported for the physical experiment.

experimental_error_bars.rule: Source error bars must not be added to, substituted for, or described as Figure 4 extraction uncertainty.

guardrails: The adopted bound is not a confidence interval.
The adopted bound is not experimental uncertainty.
The adopted bound is not model uncertainty.
The v0-to-v1 calibration shift is used only as a conservative extraction-method sensitivity bound.
